public_rationale: Later research reports describe autonomous mathematical contributions, but they do not settle this narrowly timed forecast. Marcus supplied no measurable endpoint for immediately. Neither the absence of a search result nor a result many months later establishes whether his prediction held.
limitations: Open horizon records the absence of an operational deadline; it does not extend immediately indefinitely.
This assessment does not endorse the historical assertion that Robbins was the only earlier qualifying theorem.

our_interpretation: The forecast concerns a new autonomous research proof of significance comparable to the Robbins conjecture in the immediate aftermath of the July 2025 IMO results.
Human selection of a problem and subsequent verification do not disqualify autonomy; human provision of essential proof steps does.
Immediately supplies no defensible numerical deadline. I do not substitute the evaluation date, or a fixed number of months, for it.
The historical assertion about Robbins is background to this forecast, not a separately graded claim.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive, independently assessed record establishes that no qualifying autonomous proof emerged during an agreed interpretation of the immediate aftermath.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A dated, independently verified autonomous proof of a new theorem of comparable or greater significance emerged in the immediate aftermath of the IMO results.
